# Poimandres

Poimandres carries the Poimandres dark code-editor palette into Obsidian for low-light writing. It provides syntax highlighting with distinct color differentiation across notes, and its colors can be adjusted in Obsidian's theme settings.

![Poimandres screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yoghastly/poimandres-obsidian/HEAD/dark.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Poimandres"
    author: "yoghastly"
    repo:   "yoghastly/poimandres-obsidian"
    slug:   "poimandres"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/poimandres"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/yoghastly/poimandres-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yoghastly/poimandres-obsidian/HEAD/dark.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply the Poimandres dark code-editor palette to Obsidian for a focused, low-light writing experience. Provide clear syntax highlighting and distinct color differentiation across notes, with options to customize colors in Obsidian's theme settings."
}
```
